Not in NIST, not in EU AI Act, not in OSCAL. DOMAIN (D) — govState is module-private and its only two callers build `{ label: relPath, relPath }` with NO templateKey, on `governance/threat-model.md` and `governance/evaluation-rubric.md`. In src/lib/mission.ts, artifactState returns "untouched" only for a templateKey-ful file byte-identical to its template or for the `adr`/`contracts` directory special cases, so here st ∈ {missing, in-progress, filled} and "untouched" is unreachable. Likewise inProgressCause re-runs the SAME placeholder test that made artifactState say `in-progress` — for a templateKey-less artifact both are `(content.match(PLACEHOLDER)||[]).length >= 3` — so on this path the cause can only ever be "placeholders", and "below-floor" is unreachable. With the guard forced true, govState answers `"raw template"` for every state. RECIPE: `runward init --yes`, then `rm runward/governance/threat-model.md runward/governance/evaluation-rubric.md`, then `runward compliance iso-42001`. Shipped build: ISO §4 `**not counted** (missing)`, terminal `Governance  threat model missing, eval rubric missing`. MUTATED: `**not counted** (raw template)` and `threat model raw template, eval rubric raw template` — the pack asserts a scaffold is on disk for a file that is not there, while `check` prints `✗ Threat model — file missing`. (The state also changes `filled` → `raw template` on a filled mission, but neither surface renders the state when the boolean is true, so that half is not observable.)
